params.body:
First of three. The Activiteit screen is going to become a tab inside Inzichten, and Inzichten cannot host a tab in its current shape: it is one file of 1,569 lines with the styling, the markup and eleven hundred lines of javascript in it.

This step only moves things. No behaviour change, no markup change, not one line of the charts rewritten.

- `resources/css/insights.css` — the `<style>` block, now through the build. lightningcss refuses a broken selector, and the file gets a hash so a browser cannot serve yesterday's version.
- `resources/js/insights.js` — the six chart builders and the wiring. Now linted, minified and cache-busted; until today none of that could touch it, and a typo here took the whole page down without anything going red.
- The blade goes from 1,569 lines to 369.

## The one real change

The script held two blade insertions, and those two were the entire reason it could not leave the blade. They travel as `data-` attributes on the root element now, which is why the move is possible at all:

```
data-data-url="{{ route('insights.index.data') }}"
data-dealers-url="{{ route('insights.index.dealers') }}"
```

The extraction was done with a script rather than by hand — transcribing eleven hundred lines is asking for a silent mistake — and it asserts that exactly two insertions were found and that no blade survives in the javascript.

## The seam this creates

The two halves now meet only through element ids. Nothing would complain if a future edit dropped one: the chart would simply not be drawn, in silence. So `TheInsightsPageKeepsItsHooksTest` reads the script for every `getElementById` it uses and requires the page to carry it, apart from the four the script writes itself.

It found one immediately while I was writing it — `kopieer-mails` is built inside the dealer panel, not in the page — which is exactly the kind of thing that would otherwise be discovered by a chart quietly missing.

Two more tests keep the halves apart: no `{{` in the javascript, no `<script>` or `<style>` back in the blade.

## What comes next

Second step: the tab shell in Inzichten, with the current content as one tab. Third: rebuild Activiteit as real analytics — one measure at a time, sliced many ways, comparison as the main thing rather than a grey footnote, and drill-down on every number. The current Activiteit screen borrowed its layout from Werking, which is a status screen, and that is why it reads flat.

## Verified

`npm run build` produces both files (27 kB of javascript, 6 kB of css). `npm run lint` passes with zero errors. The existing `InsightsTest`, `InsightsCountsWhatItSaysTest`, `BuildContractTest` and `StylesheetSyntaxTest` all stay green.

Local suite: the same nine failures as on a clean `main` in my environment (two known `ListPageHeadersTest`, six `IntegrationSmokeTest` reading an `OUTBOUND_IMPACT` from my local `.env`, one warranty test) — my local database is still carrying rows an earlier test of mine leaked through DDL. CI runs on a fresh database.
params.title: Insights out of one file
